releases.name: Field Twin Viridian 2026-10-15
releases.body: First version. Added a plate reader status and reading while parked, with an upload status. Then added plate sightings, a best photo, a pass on state and color, and a page for each plate.

jobs.description: A field twin app that reads plates and keeps a list of sightings.

releases.name: Stompbox Lab 2026-10-15
releases.body: Every phone in a room now gets the list of every other phone. Fixed seating so each phone gets the right message. Added more grooves: House, Jungle, Disco, Funk, Boom Bap, Trap, Reggaeton, and Rock, each with its own tempo.

releases.name: Stompbox Lab 2026-10-14
releases.body: Corrected the phone markers.

releases.name: Stompbox Lab 2026-10-11
releases.body: Created the app with a light theme and a board snapshot. Added a light and dark switch. Added a server clock and looped grooves on every phone, then sign in. A single room now holds every app, and knobs stay on each phone with its own voice.

jobs.description: A pedal board and synth with grooves that play across many phones.

releases.name: Hoofer Sync 2026-10-15
releases.body: Added a dance floor with a dancer for every phone in the room. A phone now dances as soon as it joins. Loop parts only go to phones that are playing. Added tabs for Floor, Moves, Wardrobe, and Studio, a move maker, outfits, famous routines, and up to fifteen dancers.

releases.name: Hoofer Sync 2026-10-14
releases.body: Created the app as a choreography sequencer dancer that joins the Stompbox Lab band room.

jobs.description: A dance floor with a dancer for each phone in the band room.

releases.name: Inkrunner 2026-10-17
releases.body: Created the game as a comic ink driving sim. Added air tricks, a track loop with barricades, a crash reset, and a lap ghost. Added outer walls, a wider road, zoom out, and a brace button. Fixed a crash at the wall band and opened free driving outside the walls.

jobs.description: A comic ink cold gas driving sim with tricks and lap ghosts.

releases.name: Tapperator 2026-10-17
releases.body: Created the app as a steering wheel drum kit with a five round calibration, a four tab looper, and room sync. Added sampling for each instrument with five sets per pad. Players now start with two pads and add more later, with striker tips and mix-up warnings.

jobs.description: A steering wheel drum kit with calibration, a looper, and room sync.

releases.name: Retro Software Catalog 2026-10-17
releases.body: Created the retro software catalog. Added retro social link buttons in the footer. Added Field Twin Glaucous, Inkrunner, Tapperator, and the catalog itself, and fixed the Control Troll address.

jobs.description: A retro styled software catalog that lists the developer's apps.

releases.name: Talk Box Studio 2026-10-17
releases.body: Created the talk box app. Added separate mic and speaker choice and a feedback guard.

jobs.description: A talk box studio with separate mic and speaker choice.
